new_jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Specialist - Bonus & Incentive Planning

new_jobs.title: Sr. Manager, LSP Operations & Workforce Strategy (Taiwan)
new_jobs.jd: **The group you’ll be a part of** The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes. **The impact you’ll make** You will lead Lam Taiwan's Local Service Provider (LSP) program, the outsourced field service workforce that supports Lam's Field Service Engineers (FSEs) with tool installation and maintenance at customer sites. You own LSP workforce strategy, supplier management, contracts execution, and engineer capability development, so that enough skilled LSP engineers are ready to meet customer ramp demand. You will manage LSP suppliers as an extension of Lam's own Service Team, with the same standards, discipline and accountability. You will work closely with Account Team (AT) site management, and you are accountable for both training quality and installation quality. **What You’ll Do** * Workforce Strategy & Capacity Planning * Set the LSP workforce strategy, the long-term capacity and capability roadmap. * Work with Account Teams, Planners and the Global Field Operations (GFO) team so LSP capacity matches customer ramp forecasts, upside and downside demand scenarios. * Own LSP hiring strategy, retention programs and succession planning. * Supplier Management: Run LSPs as a Lam Service Team * Manage the Taiwan LSP vendors (currently about 9) as an extension of the Lam Service Team, not as transactional vendors. * Hold LSP engineers to the same operating standards Lam applies to its own service staff: work procedures, safety, quality, conduct, reporting and escalation. * Set a regular review schedule with each supplier on people readiness, skills, deployment and performance, the way a service manager runs their own team. * Run the quarterly LSP scorecard and business reviews (QBRs), tracking hiring, retention, certification, workmanship quality and cost. * Build strong working relationships with supplier leadership; drive corrective actions and lead the decision to replace vendors that keep underperforming. * Account Team & Site Management Interface * Act as the main LSP contact for Account Team site management teams at customer fabs. * Agree each site's LSP manpower needs, skill mix, priorities and deployment plan with site managers, and handle site-level issues and escalations. * Give regular updates on LSP staffing, certification status, and the quality and performance of LSP work. * Make sure LSP engineers follow site and customer requirements, including access, badging, safety and fab rules. * Training Quality & Consistency with Lam Standards * Ensure all LSP training follows Lam's recommended curriculum, procedures and certification standards, so every supplier and site trains the same way. * Run the LSP training and certification roadmap to shorten time to productivity and speed up Level 2 / Level 3 certification. * Check how well training works, including on-the-job training (OJT), and stop suppliers from relying on their own SOPs or informal knowledge sharing. * Work with the Technical Managers and Training Center on curriculum, hands-on training capacity and the digital learning library. * Installation Quality & Workmanship * Own LSP installation quality: all Tool Install (T0/T1) work must use Lam's formal installation procedures, checklists and work instructions, with proper oversight on site. * Lead the response to installation quality incidents: immediate containment, root cause, corrective action and long-term governance. * Track workmanship and installation quality KPIs and include them in supplier scorecards and incentives. * Commercial, Contract & Budget Management * Own LSP contracts execution as the business owner, including Master Service Agreements (MSA), Statements of Work (SOW). Support pricing management, working with Operation Manger (ROM), Global Indirect Procurement (GIP) and Legal * LSP budget and spending forecast, purchase requests, and approval of invoices and timecards will be own by the Operation Manager. * Operations, Compliance & Risk * Oversee onboarding and offboarding of LSP engineers and coordination of global loan engineers. * Make sure contractors meet EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) standards, labor law and co-employment rules, and export control requirements. * Maintain KPI dashboards (Power BI) and lead process improvement. * People Leadership * Lead, coach and develop the LSP Operations team, with clear roles and a regular review schedule. **Who We’re Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science. * 10+ years in the semiconductor equipment industry, including field service, service operations or supplier management. * 5+ years managing vendors or contractors, including contract negotiation, pricing and budget control. * Experience managing or leading a field service team, and running outsourced teams to service team standards. * Proven experience working with Account Teams or customer site management in a fab. * Solid knowledge of semiconductor tool installation and maintenance, enough to judge training quality and installation workmanship. * Proven people manager. * Fluent English and Mandarin, written and spoken. * Strong strategic thinking, executive presentation and stakeholder management skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience from more than one side of the industry: OEM, supplier and/or customer fab. * Knowledge of Taiwan labor law for dispatched or contracted workers. **Our commitment** We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. *Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

As a **Fleet & Retail Solutions Manager** , you will play a key role in building and improving logistics solutions across two areas: **fleet operations and retail delivery** . **On the fleet side,** you will develop scalable solutions for fleet onboarding, management, and dispatch operations, while improving courier delivery and support experiences. You will work closely with Logistics & Network Ops, Taiwan Earner Ops, CommOps, and Global Product teams to identify operational challenges and drive product and process improvements. **On the retail side** , you will design and implement delivery solutions for retail shippers in Taiwan, working with Commercial, Partner Engineers, Global Product, and Operations teams to turn new delivery use cases into scalable solutions. Across both areas, you will **bridge local operational needs with Global Product capabilities** , translating business and operational challenges into clear product requirements and helping shape solutions that support the growth of Uber Logistics in Taiwan. **Your Impacts in this Role** **Build & Optimize Fleet Solutions** * Scale fleet onboarding and management: Develop standardized onboarding processes, training materials, and knowledge bases for logistics fleets, covering operational requirements and tools such as TMS and the Uber Driver app. Identify opportunities to simplify fleet management workflows and improve operational efficiency. * Improve fleet dispatch operations: Identify and address operational or product gaps in fleet configuration, dispatch workflows, and delivery execution to improve fleet utilization, reliability, and operational scalability. * Enhance the end-to-end courier experience: Identify and reduce friction across the logistics delivery journey, including the TMS Driver Module, Uber Driver app, hub pickup, and last-mile delivery. or integration issues. **Basic Qualifications** **The Experience You’ll Bring** * Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in product operations/ management, technical consultant/ implementation, new_jobs.jd: Header Purpose and Scope of the Job The Business Analyst is a strategic role within the Operations & Business Analytics (O&BA) Unit, reporting to the O&BA Lead. The role focuses on income safeguarding, forecasting, and performance interpretation, with a clear mandate to strengthen organisational decision-making around revenue resilience and growth. Unlike traditional technical or reporting-centric analyst roles, this position is explicitly business- and income-oriented. It owns how system outputs and analytical results are interpreted, framed, and acted upon from a fundraising and financial performance perspective. The primary purpose of the role is to increase decision confidence and speed by transforming complex and often fragmented performance data into clear options, trade-offs, and risk implications for leadership. The role works closely with the Data & Technology team to ensure analytics are based on governed data, consistent definitions and reliable reporting infrastructure. Data & Technology team owns technical delivery, platform stability, data architecture, safety and operational insights. The Business Analyst owns business interpretation and decision framing and partners with the Data & Technology team to prioritise data requirements, resolve data quality issues and ensure outputs are decision-ready. The role acts as a key interface between Fundraising, Data & Technology, and Finance, ensuring income resilience, strategic alignment, and shared understanding of performance drivers across the organisation.Work priorities are aligned with FRE strategic priorities to ensure analytical capacity remains focused on income-critical decisions. Success in this role is demonstrated through improved forecast reliability, earlier identification of income risks, and increased use of analytical insight by FRE managers in operational decision-making.
